verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Outlook exposes a Microsoft Graph mail API that agents could call, but the pack has no evidence of issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials, such as permission scopes, app registrations or restricted tokens. The send-on-behalf delegation feature is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
